title: CS-[BiC-PiC]-NiCl4: a green and effective heterogeneous catalyst for one-pot synthesis of 2,3-dihydroquinazolin-4(1H)-one derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8337-8355
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07849K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Narges Seyedi, Maryam Mousapour, Mohammad Rizehbandi, Farhad Shirini
In this study, CS-[BiC-PiC]-NiCl4 was designed, synthesized, and fully characterized by using various techniques. In continue this reagent was used for the promotion of the synthesis of 2,3-dihydroquinazolin-4(1H)-one derivatives.
